oboard/mocket: 通用 Web 框架，路由与中间件齐备，接口风格接近 Express。
A general web framework with routing and middleware, in an Express-like style.
bobzhang/crescent: Web 框架，出自 MoonBit 语言作者之手，实现偏探索性质，适合读代码而不是直接上生产。
A web framework from MoonBit's own author — more exploratory than production-ready, worth reading as much as using.
jaredzhou/pony: 轻量 HTTP 框架与路由器（Go 的 Chi 风格），只需要路由和中间件时用它。
Lightweight HTTP framework and router in Chi style — reach for it when all you need is routing and middleware.
RabitLogic/mbit: Gin 风格的 Web 框架，API 设计和 Go 生态高度对应，从 Gin 迁过来几乎不用重新学。
Gin-style web framework whose API maps closely to Go's ecosystem — almost no relearning from Gin.
moonbitstack/moonapi: 类型化 Web 框架：路由、参数、响应都纳入类型检查，把错误挡在编译期。
A typed web framework that puts routes, params and responses under type checking, moving errors to compile time.
daqing/moonway: 全栈 Web 框架，前后端在同一个工程里组织，不用拆两套构建。
A full-stack framework keeping frontend and backend in one project instead of two build pipelines.
wflixu/Halo: Koa 洋葱模型的中间件框架，支持结构化并发和流式响应，重中间件编排的服务适合它。
Koa-style onion middleware with structured concurrency and streaming responses — good for services built around middleware composition.
kupas/express: Express 兼容的 Web 框架，底层走 uWebSockets，从 Node 迁过来改动最小。
Express-compatible framework backed by uWebSockets — the smallest diff when porting from Node.
KKKIIO/moondark: Django 风格的后端框架，建在 moonback 之上，自带工程结构的约定。
Django-inspired backend framework built on moonback, with opinions about project structure.
moonbitstack/moonzero: 服务框架，面向服务拆分而不是单机 HTTP 应用，边界比 Web 框架高一层。
A service framework aimed at splitting services rather than serving a single HTTP app — one level above a web framework.
anccnuer/onho: Hono 风格的轻量 Web 框架，路由和中间件刚好够用。
A lightweight Hono-style web framework with just enough routing and middleware.
moonbitstack/moondb: 数据库访问的标准接口层：定义驱动与查询层的契约，本身不实现任何数据库。对应 Go 的 database/sql、Python 的 DB-API，想让上层代码不绑死某个数据库时用它。

The standard database access interface: it defines the driver/query-layer contract without implementing any database. MoonBit's counterpart to Go's database/sql or Python's DB-API — use it to keep upper layers from binding to one engine.
oboard/morm: 轻量 ORM：类型化查询加代码生成，支持多种数据库引擎，接口克制。
Lightweight ORM with typed queries and code generation across several engines, keeping the API small.
moonbitstack/moonorm: ORM 与 SQL 工具包，模型映射和查询构建都在同一套里。
An ORM plus SQL toolkit covering both model mapping and query building.
wflixu/Orion: Derive 加代码生成的 ORM：用 Schema DSL 描述表，自动产出类型安全 CRUD 和查询构建器。
A derive-and-codegen ORM: describe tables in a schema DSL and get type-safe CRUD plus a query builder generated.
zen314/shadow: 简单 ORM，接口直白，中小项目起步够用。
A simple ORM with a straightforward API — enough to get a small project moving.
moonbitlang/async: 官方异步库，协程调度加 IO 抽象，生态里的默认底座，其他库大多兼容它。
The official async library with coroutine scheduling and IO abstractions — the ecosystem default that most other libraries build on.
peter-jerry-ye/async: Promise、事件循环、IO 三件套的异步库，接口偏 JS 习惯。
Async library offering promises, an event loop and IO, with an API shaped like JavaScript.
didiLjf/moonorbit: Actor 并发框架，用消息传递代替共享状态，适合状态多、并发写冲突多的服务。
An actor concurrency framework that replaces shared state with message passing — useful where concurrent writes contend.
kalculos/miao: 以 libuv 为默认运行时的异步 IO 库，行为和 Node 生态最接近。
Async IO library backed by libuv as its default runtime, behaving closest to the Node ecosystem.
Yu-zh/data: serde 形态的序列化框架：一套数据模型，多种格式共用同一套序列化逻辑，换格式不用重写。
A serde-shaped serialization framework: one data model shared across formats, so switching format doesn't mean rewriting.
chensuiyi/bm2: 给 Bun / Node.js 应用用的 Linux 进程管理器，本身用 MoonBit 写。
A Linux process manager for Bun / Node.js apps, itself written in MoonBit.
mizchi/actrun: 兼容 GitHub Actions 的本地 CI runner，workflow 能在自己机器上跑，不必等远端。
A local CI runner compatible with GitHub Actions, so workflows run on your own machine instead of waiting on a remote.
kupas/pm3: PM2 式的语言无关进程管理器，内置日志轮转，跑什么语言的进程都行。
A PM2-like, language-agnostic process manager with built-in log rotation.
tiye/redstart: 面向本地开发的轻量进程管理器，一次起停一组服务。
A lightweight process manager for local development that starts and stops a group of services together.
colmugx/posoco: 六边形架构（端口-适配器）的 Agent 框架：定义扩展端口和 Agent 循环，LLM 供应商与工具都可替换。
A hexagonal (ports-and-adapters) agent framework: extension ports and an agent loop, with LLM providers and tools swappable.
colmugx/mcp: 类型安全的 MCP SDK，服务端客户端都有，STDIO 和 HTTP 两种传输都支持。
A type-safe MCP SDK covering both server and client, over STDIO or HTTP transports.
golemcloud/golem_sdk: Golem 平台的 SDK，用来构建可持久化、故障自恢复的 agent，代价是绑定到这个托管平台。
The SDK for the Golem platform, for durable and fault-tolerant agents — at the cost of depending on that hosted platform.
weopqrst/agent: LangChain 核心库的 MoonBit 版：类型安全、可组合、可嵌入，LLM 客户端走 mizchi/llm。
The MoonBit take on LangChain's core: type-safe, composable and embeddable, with LLM clients coming from mizchi/llm.
soehi/moonlm: 本地 LLM 推理引擎加强类型 agent 运行时，不依赖外部 API 也能跑模型。
A local LLM inference engine plus a strongly-typed agent runtime — models run without calling an external API.
moonbitlang/yacc: 官方 LR(1) 语法分析器生成器，写文法出解析器，适合整门语言的完整语法。
The official LR(1) parser generator: write a grammar, get a parser — suited to a full language grammar.
cogna-dev/parkit: nom 风格的解析器组合子框架，用函数组合拼解析逻辑，适合局部格式而不是整门语言。
A nom-style parser combinator framework that assembles parsing from composed functions — for local formats rather than whole languages.
moonbitlang/quickcheck: 官方 QuickCheck 实现：用属性描述行为，自动生成输入去找反例。
The official QuickCheck: describe behavior as properties and let generated inputs hunt for counterexamples.
moonrockz/moonspec: BDD 测试框架，支持 Gherkin 语法和 Cucumber 表达式，需求文档可以直接变成测试。
A BDD framework supporting Gherkin and Cucumber expressions, so requirement documents can turn into tests.
aspnmy/moonitest: 集成测试框架，通过真实 Docker / TCP / HTTP 打后端接口，是单元测试的补充而不是替代。
An integration testing framework that hits real Docker / TCP / HTTP backends — a complement to unit tests, not a replacement.
Duckweed/moon-proof: 文档示例的持续验证框架：把文档里的代码块抽出来隔离编译运行，回答「文档里的例子还都对吗」。
Continuous verification for documentation examples: extract code blocks, compile and run them in isolation, and answer whether the docs still work.
Milky2018/wasmoon: WebAssembly 运行时：自带 JIT 和解释器，支持 WASI 与 Component Model，可以在 MoonBit 里加载并执行 wasm 模块。
A WebAssembly runtime with its own JIT and interpreter, supporting WASI and the Component Model — load and execute wasm modules from MoonBit.
